name: DIAGEO PL   DRN
summary: Diageo plc is a major global producer, marketer, and distributor of alcoholic beverages including Scotch whisky, vodka, gin, rum, and tequila, sold under brands such as Johnnie Walker, Smirnoff, Captain Morgan, Baileys, and Guinness. Founded in 1886, headquartered in London, United Kingdom. This row represents the company's Brazilian Depositary Receipt (BDR).
